_howto: Testimonials shown in the 'What people say' section of imadalisyed.com (homepage).
The section stays hidden until this list has at least one entry, so it is safe to push empty.
Only add words people actually sent you, and only with their permission to publish them.
Paste their text as they wrote it (fixing obvious typos is fine). One block per person.
name          (required) their name as they want it shown, e.g. 'Jane D.' if they prefer
role          (optional) e.g. 'Student, MAC246 Advanced Network Security, LaGuardia'
relationship  (optional) one of: student, colleague, teammate, professor, mentor, manager
-> drives the filter buttons (Students / Colleagues / Teammates / Professors ...)
Never put email addresses or phone numbers in this file - it is public.
